bagPolicy.summary: Petco Park enforces a clear bag policy to ensure fan safety and expedite entry. Only specific types and sizes of bags are allowed, and all bags are subject to search.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small clutch bags/wallets up to 6.5” x 4.5”
Seat cushions without pockets up to 18” wide
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and diaper bags may be exceptions.

parking.note: Petco Park is in downtown San Diego's East Village, served by the Padres Parkade, Tailgate Park, and many nearby garages and lots. Prepaid parking through the team or SpotHero is cheaper than drive-up. The MTS Trolley stops at the Gaslamp/Convention Center stations a short walk away.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Petco Park's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Petco Park offers a variety of food and beverage options including classic comfort foods with modern twists, such as crispy chicken tenders, cheeseburgers, and specialty hot dogs. Highlights include the Bacon Wrapped Hot Dog and Pastrami Fry, with a selection of local and popular beers available at the Beer Garden.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Petco Park, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Petco Park's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Since tickets retrieved within the MLB Ballpark app will now be considered printed, the tickets will not be available for pickup at Will Call.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Petco Park. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
